feat(camellia): add icon type filter to icon page

Summary:
- read icon type options from console marks via a shared helper
- add an icon type select filter to the icon management page and pass
  the selected type to the backend group query
- add locale entries for the icon type labels used by the filter

Rationale:
- expose only icon type options available in the active product context
- reuse backend filtering so the page behavior stays aligned with the
  existing icon group API

Tests:
- pnpm run typecheck:camellia
- pnpm run build:camellia
